There is more in Settings than you need on day one.
Users is where you invite your office manager or your bookkeeper and choose what each of them can see.
Document Statuses lets you rename the stages a payment or an invoice moves through to match the words you already use.
Trades is the list you tag your subs with.
Document Templates is the layout your invoices print in — your logo, your wording, your footer.
Have a look when you have a quiet afternoon.
